description:
Scope: planning only for lib/zaq/engine/channel_history_membership.ex lines 78, 111, 151, 161, 199, 210, 228, 260. Implementation owner: existing Zaq.Engine.ChannelHistoryMembership; no production changes planned. Exclusive implementation test path: test/zaq/engine/channel_history_membership_test.exs. Existing neighboring tests of admin/Action are context only, not edit targets. Action reuse: not applicable — add regression/guard tests for existing public operations, no new or changed executable operation. No docs changes; no new feature journey, so no new E2E.

Test-first cases, using existing DataCase async: false setup (connector, Alice/Bob links, HistoryIngress.capture Shared room), process-private SnapshotRouter with explicit Event replies, People.create_person/add_channel, ChannelHistoryResource.for, Permissions.grant/list_direct, Conversations.list_canonical_messages, and Repo reloads. Assert exact result atoms, grant source_key/person IDs, absence of leaked access, and unchanged state/grants after rollback. Keep separate test examples, not a giant matrix:
1. L78: apply_event malformed maps (missing key, nil/nonpositive config, empty/overlong member/platform) return {:error, :invalid_membership_event} without any state/grant change or dispatch.
2. L111: well-shaped event on existing Shared room with invalid :operation or negative/noninteger revision; MembershipOrder.event returns {:error, :invalid_membership_event}; assert transaction rollback and unchanged membership_state/grants. Optionally seed an unversioned snapshot then ordered event to assert :unordered_snapshot distinctly.
3. L151: refresh valid UUID of Direct or disabled/archived connector's Shared root => {:error, :unsupported_membership_refresh}, unchanged grants; no Channels dispatch. Note missing UUID tests the same fallback.
4. L161: complete router response with member_ids nonlist (e.g. nil/map) and list >10_000; assert {:error, :invalid_snapshot}, prior provider read grant and root state unchanged; existing nil-entry case covers L158, not L161. Avoid 10k Person fixtures: only identifier strings.
5. L199: Permissions.grant failure. A valid resolved active Person, read right, nonempty source and current resource make the normal changeset valid; no public :permissions seam is passed to refresh. Do not fake internal module, globally replace Repo, corrupt FK, or install test-only hooks. Only add a test if a real supported DB rejection is identified reproducibly without concurrent sandbox races; assert exact rollback and preserved prior grants/state. Otherwise mark as unreachable under valid public inputs and record coverage exception.
6. L210: Permissions.revoke uses default PermissionRevoker.delete -> Repo.delete; normal provider permission deletion succeeds, and refresh passes no revoker option. A DB constraint/trigger solely for a test or global monkey-patch is inappropriate. Cover normal revoke and manual-source preservation with existing tests; document error branch as currently unreachably injectable, pending a genuine production error case.
7. L228: apply_event first identifies Shared root, then locked_root rechecks enabled provider/config under advisory lock. To exercise the TOCTOU recheck, only if a deterministic integration harness can coordinate two sandbox-allowed DB processes: hold matching resource advisory transaction lock, observe event worker's root lookup through existing Repo telemetry, disable/archive config and commit before releasing lock; assert {:error, :unsupported_membership_refresh}, unchanged state/grants. No sleeps, polling or new production hooks. If telemetry/barrier cannot prove ordering, declare race branch blocked; separate disabled-before-call case checks L151, not L228.
8. L260: apply_event :add for well-formed unknown member with valid revision; assert {:ok, %{status: :applied}}, state records evidence but no Person created and no provider grant added. Check existing Alice/Bob access unaffected; match_by_channel must not infer identity.

Mocks/isolation: use SnapshotRouter only as external Channels boundary, assert exact Event action/request; no NodeRouter blanket stubs or network, no global Mox/env mutation. Event paths use real DB/People/Permissions. DataCase and sandbox isolate writes; concurrent L228 needs Sandbox.allow for known spawned process(es), completion via Task.await/messages, and :telemetry.attach/detach in on_exit if used. Unique fixture identifiers as necessary. Property assessment: MembershipOrder ordering/idempotency/security invariants already receive example coverage here; if extending broad malformed-event guards, consider bounded StreamData property on public apply_event (invalid fields always fail closed without writes), but no property for one-off DB exception branches. Validate implementation later with isolated `mix test test/zaq/engine/channel_history_membership_test.exs`, then `mix q`, coverage handoff per workflow after review; `mix precommit` at final approval gate. No tests run for planning.

comments.text: Implemented tests in test/zaq/engine/channel_history_membership_test.exs for malformed membership input, invalid ordered operations/rollback, disabled connector fallback, malformed and oversized snapshots with rollback preservation, and unknown member events without identity/grant creation. Targeted test passed: mix test test/zaq/engine/channel_history_membership_test.exs (9 tests, 0 failures). Reachability exceptions: grant/revoke error branches (lines 199/210) have no public injection seam and normal valid DB operations succeed; did not add artificial DB failures. Lock-recheck race (line 228) not attempted because no deterministic existing telemetry/barrier coordination harness was identified; disabled-before-call path is covered separately. No production, support, or other test files changed.
